text: My grandson is 15 months and his temperature is 39.7. I've never seen it that high on him and I'm frightened to be honest. His mum and dad are away so it's me tonight. He hasn't done a poo for three days now and he's very grumpy about it, pushing and going red in the face then nothing. His colour is normal, lips normal pink, I've checked under the lamp. Nappies are wet, I changed a heavy one about an hour ago. Please tell me if I should be doing something.
